detail.longDescription: https://github.com/queue-theory/queue-theory Queue theory is the mathematical study of waiting lines a.k.a. queues. We use queueing in our software development, and queue theory for analyzing and optimizing our practices and processes, such as our customer service responsiveness, project management kanban planning, inter-process communication message queues, and devops continuous deployment pipelines. I wrote a queue theory tutorial in 2019 and today I'm happy to share version 3. It has better notations, examples, images, translations, and more open source licenses thanks to Creative Commons and the Open Government License. On a personal note queue theory is especially important for my current teams who work on health care medical software for hospitals. Queue theory helps analyze many aspects of patients queuing for care, for diagnostic test requests queuing for laboratory time, for imaging queuing for radiologists to read them, and much more. Ask me anything. If you like this please star and share because this helps my coworkers see open source reaching peple.
